# Sanad Care

> Sanad Care is a home nursing and home healthcare provider based in Marrakech, Morocco. State-registered nurses (IDE) deliver medical care at home, in hotels, and in riads: elderly care, post-surgery recovery, IV therapy, injections, wound care, physiotherapy, chronic disease monitoring, and medical assistance for tourists. Available 24/7.

## Services

- **Home Nursing** (`/en/services`, `/fr/services`, `/ar/services`): 26 services including elderly care, post-operative care, injections and IV therapy at home, wound and pressure ulcer care, chronic disease monitoring, palliative care, newborn and postpartum care.
- **Medical Tourism** (`/en/tourism`): medical assistance for tourists at their hotel or riad, including illness and injury follow-up and coordination with doctors.
- **Blood Tests at Home** (`/en/venipuncture`): venipuncture service for patients, pregnant women, athletes (partner gym discounts), and tourists.
- **Pre-Travel Health Questionnaire** (`/en/document`): form for visitors to share health details before arrival.
